steps.note: The milk is soured, so the acid makes the proteins lose their charge and the milk coagulates into a curd.
The curd is heated to stop the culture once it has formed.
The whey is removed and the curd formed into a mass.
The cheese is given guar or carob gum, which keeps water from separating and extends shelf life.

sources.text: The order of cream, homogenising, souring at about 22 °C, heating, whey removal and gums is from this article; its heating range is uncited there, so none is given.
